### 📝 Flutter Portfolio Submission

Please ensure all checks below are met before submitting your Pull Request:

- [ ] **Working URL:** My portfolio link is live and publicly accessible (no localhost or dead domains).
- [ ] **Flutter / Dart Focus:** My portfolio is built with Flutter Web OR explicitly showcases my Flutter/Dart projects.
- [ ] **Country Section:** Added under the correct `## COUNTRYNAME` (in UPPERCASE). If the country wasn't listed yet, I added it in alphabetical order.
- [ ] **Code Provided:** Included a link to the open-source repository or my GitHub profile.
- [ ] **Table Format:** Followed the 4-column format:
  ```markdown
  | **Name** | [link](https://your-portfolio.com) | [GitHub / Source](https://github.com/...) | Core Highlights • State Management |
  ```

---
*Thank you for contributing to the global Flutter community! 💙*
